chunks: But Pharaoh said: 'You have come to accept belief in Him without my permission! This surely is a plot you have hatched to expel the people from the land. You will soon come to know.'
ai.seo_question: What was Pharaoh's accusation against the Israelites regarding their faith in Moses?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-A'raf, Pharaoh interprets the common people's acceptance of Moses' miracles not as spiritual awakening but as a calculated political conspiracy to usurp his authority. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of the tyrant's tendency to politicize faith, viewing religious devotion as a threat to his temporal power. The verse underscores the theme of divine signs being dismissed by those entrenched in worldly dominance.
